aboutGame.title: What is Pax Autocratica?
paragraphs: The official site frames Pax Autocratica as a satirical totalitarian colony sim crossed with an FPS roguelite. Its advertised loop moves from shaping a population and building the state apparatus to expeditions and combat.
The current identity is the Multiverse game on Steam App ID 1067360. Platform, pricing, and release details can change, so the linked primary pages remain the source of truth for access and updates.

Detailed controls, win conditions, and a complete build-specific strategy are not verified in this run, so this page is a source-backed orientation rather than a finished walkthrough.
